verses.pali: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Mendicants, someone with four qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.
Without examining or scrutinizing, they praise those deserving of criticism,
and they criticize those deserving of praise.

verses.pali: ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṁ upadaṁseti, ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṁ upadaṁseti—
verses.english: They arouse faith in things that are dubious, and they don’t arouse faith in things that are inspiring.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: Someone with these four qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: Someone with four qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.
After examining and scrutinizing, they criticize those deserving of criticism,
and they praise those deserving of praise.

verses.pali: anuvicca pariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṁ upadaṁseti
verses.english: They don’t arouse faith in things that are dubious,

verses.pali: anuvicca pariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṁ upadaṁseti—
verses.english: and they do arouse faith in things that are inspiring.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti.
verses.english: Someone with these four qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
